meta.title: Enca Insurance | Health, Life, Auto and Home Insurance in Hallandale Beach, FL
meta.description: Bilingual insurance agency in Hallandale Beach, Florida. Help with Obamacare health plans, plus life, auto and home insurance. Call (786) 728-1828 for a free quote.

hero.title: Health insurance help, in English and Spanish.
hero.text: We're a local agency in Hallandale Beach. We compare health plans for you, check if you qualify for help paying for them, and sign you up. We also offer life, auto and home insurance.
hero.photo_alt: Reception area of the Enca Insurance office

enrollment.title: Open Enrollment for 2027 health plans is happening now.
enrollment.text: If you don't get health insurance through work, this is the time to sign up or change your plan for 2027.

steps.label: Dec 15, 2026
steps.text: Last day to sign up for coverage that starts January 1.

steps.label: Jan 15, 2027
steps.text: Open Enrollment ends. Plans chosen after December 15 start February 1.

health.title: Health insurance (Obamacare)
health.text: Affordable Care Act plans, often called Obamacare, are for people who don't get health insurance through work. Many people qualify for financial help that lowers the monthly cost. We find out what you qualify for and explain your options in plain words.

steps.title: Tell us about your household
steps.text: Who needs coverage, your ZIP code and your expected income for next year. By phone or at our office.

steps.title: We compare your options
steps.text: We look at the plans in your area, the monthly cost, the deductibles and which doctors are included.

steps.title: We sign you up and stay with you
steps.text: We complete your enrollment and help you during the year with questions, changes and renewals.

health.note: Our help is free. The plan costs the same as if you signed up on your own.
health.image_alt: A couple getting help choosing a health plan

items.title: Life insurance
items.text: Protect your family's future. We help you choose between term and permanent life insurance, with an amount that fits your budget.

items.title: Auto insurance
items.text: Coverage that meets Florida's requirements, with options for more protection. We compare prices so you don't pay more than you need to.

items.title: Home insurance
items.text: Coverage for your home and your belongings, and help understanding your protection against hurricanes and floods.

about.title: About Enca Insurance
paragraphs: Enca Insurance is an insurance agency in Hallandale Beach, Florida. We help individuals and families find health, life, auto and home insurance, in English and Spanish.
We take the time to explain each option in plain words, so you know what you're paying for before you decide. Our priority is your safety.
[Short history: when Enca started and why]

footer.disclaimer: Enca Insurance is a licensed insurance agency. We are not connected with HealthCare.gov or any government agency.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.text: This website belongs to Enca Insurance Agents Corp., {address}.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you use our quote form, we receive what you type: your name, phone number, email address, the type of insurance you're interested in, your preferred language and your message. We don't ask for Social Security numbers, policy numbers or payment details on this website.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.text: We use this information only to answer your request and to give you insurance quotes. We don't sell or rent your information.

sections.title: Services we use
sections.text: Requests from our quote form reach us by email. The map in our contact section is provided by Google Maps, which may use cookies under Google's own privacy policy. This website itself doesn't use tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep your request for as long as we need it to help you and to meet our record-keeping duties as a licensed insurance agency.

sections.title: Your choices
sections.text: You can ask us at any time to update or delete the information you sent through this website. Contact us at {email} or {phone}.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: If we change this policy, we'll update the date at the top of this page.
